title: When the Crown Falls
author: S. M. Thornbury
blurb: Ines Vane, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
